newsitem.title: BULGARIA: YIELDS RISE ON BULGARIA 3-, 6-MTH DISCOUNT T-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: YIELDS RISE ON BULGARIA 3-, 6-MTH DISCOUNT T-BILLS.

text.p: Yields rose at Monday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry three- and six-month discount T-bills as both issues were heavily oversubscribed, Finance Ministry figures showed.

The three-month paper yielded 1.42, up from 1.40 percent for the respective maturity auctioned a week ago, and yield to maturity on the six-month issue rose to 3.62 percent from 3.50 percent at the previous auction on July 28.
The two issues auctioned on Monday were offered with no minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Par value 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
Bids received 7.64 bln levs 27.801 bln levs
Average price of bids 98.56 pct 96.27 pct
Bids approved 4.0 bln levs 8.0 bln levs
Average yield to maturity 1.42 pct 3.62 pct
